question: Does QM with gstack's QM-native edition (gstack-review, gstack-plan; gstack-investigate was dropped by amendment 1) solve more invented single-turn coding requests than plain QM, pooled over Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol?

edition.layer: gstack qm/sandbox/skills/gstack-* at the pinned edition commit

forced.soul: the matched skill's SKILL.md body, frontmatter removed

review_only_fallback.when: before the main stage starts, if (a) the plan judge fails its calibration on blind set A or C against the existing pass bar, or (b) gstack-plan leaves the QM edition on gstack main (the layer is then re-pinned); nothing switches once the main stage starts

amendment_2.band_at_check: per model, on the 24 review tasks, graded by edition-grade.ts with no judge (grader run on review trials only); Wilson 95 percent interval reported, band on the point estimate
amendment_2.plan_replies: stored ungraded in the stage results; graded by the judge the main amendment pins, metered as amendment 1 requires
amendment_2.plan_band_and_replacements: applied per model on the 24 plan tasks once judge grades exist, before the main stage starts
amendment_2.unchanged: caps, leases, trial count, arms, grader rules, endpoints, the KEEP rule, sharding

addendum.note: run details the preregistration left open, chosen before any data; no cap, count, arm, grader rule, endpoint or rule changes
addendum.blocks: block b (1-4) holds rev and plan tasks numbered 6b-5 to 6b
addendum.shard_args: --arms plain --models <opus|sol> --reps 1 --stage headroom --shards 8 --seed 1514 --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-headroom --only <the block's 12 trial ids>
addendum.tasks_on_vm: scripts/ubicloud/vm-shard.sh generates them from bank/bank-review-plan.json and bank/seed.txt (its exact bytes) with edition-fixture.ts, keyless, checks them against fixtures.json and records tasks-gen.json; a failure stops the shard before any paid call

addendum.note: details the preregistration left open, chosen before any pilot data; no cap, count, arm, grader rule, endpoint or rule changes
addendum.task_rule: the lowest-numbered task of each family
addendum.pass_rule: every trial passes the edition clean-arm check (not contaminated) and at least one trial opens its matched skill and reads it whole
addendum.cost_multiplier: pilot mean metered cost per trial / headroom mean plain cost per trial on the same 4 (task, model) pairs
addendum.replies: stored ungraded for judge calibration; the alias key grades nothing

primary_endpoint: task success per trial (0 or 1), graded on substance by harnesses/qm/gstack/edition-grade.ts

rule.statistic: edition minus plain success: per task, averaged over repetitions and over both models, then over tasks
rule.test: two-sided sign-flip permutation over 48 task clusters (24 under the review-only fallback)
rule.keep: pooled difference > 0 and p < 0.05 and each model's point estimate >= 0
rule.incomplete: no verdict when any model lacks a counted record for a task in either rule arm at the design repetition count (a missing shard, arm or task, or a cap stop)

secondary_descriptive: cost per task and per success

per_family_24x9_secondary.note: labelled secondary; neither family carries a verdict alone

mdd_points.plan_judge_fails_calibration: before the main stage: the review-only fallback (24 tasks x 18 repetitions)
mdd_points.source: power/power_amendment.py, output power/power_amendment.json (each configuration seeded fresh with seed 11); the original 72-task figures were power/power_rule.py

exclusions.infra_rerun: at most once after a named repair; the first record counts unless it ended infra_error, any other rerun does not count, and every attempt's spend counts
exclusions.model_error_when: the turn's last provider call failed

command_approval.handling: approve each pending command once, same in every arm, at most 5 per trial
command_approval.route: POST /v1/turns with approval {requestId, approved: true, scope: once} (QM 850599e9 src/api/routes/turns.ts:334)

sharding.cells: (model, task block): 2 models x 4 blocks of 12 tasks (6 per family; 6 review tasks per block under the review-only fallback)
sharding.order: seeded interleave of arms and repetitions within a cell

pilot_amendment.edition_commit_note: gstack main on 2026-11-07 07:39 UTC; contains eaf1701d (the design's draft pin), ef99eb5a (#4110, /investigate retired) and 3742ee95 (#4108, standalone /plan-eng-review cut)

image_digests.note: local image ids from the dry run's build; every arm uses the same images; each shard VM builds from the amendment commit and records its own ids in preflight.json

reduced_bank_sha256.how: bank.json with the dropped families' templates removed, everything else unchanged, written as JSON.stringify(bank, null, 2) plus a newline (that serialization reproduces bank.json byte for byte)

pilot_amendment.session_read: GET /v1/admin/sessions/:id answers items; harnesses/qm/gstack/s1-count.ts entryFromItem maps them to entries
pilot_amendment.plan_judge_metering: required in the main amendment: judge calls go through the metering proxy under the main stage's per-shard leases
pilot_amendment.secondary_per_family: review and plan each reported apart, labelled secondary (24 x 9 each, MDD 9.9, 13.0 with interaction); neither carries a verdict alone

main_amendment.decided_by: internal-task (judges, calibration balance), the Captain (calibration budget line), 2026-11-07
main_amendment.note: decisions fixed before any plan grade, label, calibration trial or main-stage trial; part 2 pins the judge code and prompt by sha256, part 3 records calibration and the plan band, and the main stage launches only from part 3

secondary.report: edition minus plain within each model beside the primary; a sign disagreement for either model goes in the TL;DR

calibration.development_set: bank authors plan replies (48) and the 6 paraphrased good probes; at most 3 rubric revisions; never used for a gate
calibration.task_rule: the ten lowest-numbered plan tasks, the same for both models

real_replies.plain: headroom replies on the ten tasks, 10 per model
real_replies.edition: pilot plan-01 reply per model plus 18 calibration trials (plan-02 to plan-10, edition, both models, 1 repetition)

calibration.labels: per constraint and item count, by a GPT-6.1 Sol reader that wrote neither the keys nor any reply, blind to arm, model and grades
calibration.primary_fails: review-only fallback before the main stage; nothing retuned
calibration.secondary_fails: run goes on; the report says the family-bias check is not available

calibration_trials.shard_args: --arms edition --models opus,sol --reps 1 --stage main --shards 1 --seed 1514 --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-calibration --only <plan-02..plan-10 edition opus and sol k1>
calibration_trials.kept_apart: own driver run id and ledger lease, own dest, replica subfolder and results folder (calibration/); the main merge refuses any turn whose run id is not qm-s1-edition-2026-11-main

main_amendment.judge_routing: both judges grade each main and forced shard on its VM after the driver exits, reopening the driver lease on ~/shard/results/ledger.sqlite (harnesses/qm/gstack/judge-shard.ts, part 2); no FROZEN_PATHS file changes
main_amendment.plan_band: primary judge on the 48 stored headroom plan replies under the 8 open headroom leases; 15 to 75 percent per model; outside it the eval stops and goes back to internal-task and the Captain
main_amendment.repetitions_fallback_by_cost_rule: dropped under the 2026-11-07 spend rule; the $520 main cap stays

projection_usd.basis: plain $0.0625 per trial (96 headroom trials), edition multiplier 1.23 (pilot, 4 pairs, one trial each), judge $0.013 per grade estimated until calibration

exposure_rate.definition: per model, share of counted edition trials with open_matched, complete_read and first_step all true
exposure_rate.interval: 95 percent task-clustered bootstrap over 48 tasks, 10000 draws, seed 7

part2.note: Amendment 3 part 2: judge code pinned, two blind labellers plus a third Opus pass, and the primary settings correction. Committed before any judge or labeller call.

primary.thinking: adaptive, always on (Opus 5.5 rejects disabled and manual budgets)
primary.tool_choice: auto (Opus 5.5 rejects a forced tool); one strict record_grade tool and a closing line asking for one call; a reply without the call is a failed call

secondary.cache: prompt_cache_options.mode explicit, breakpoint on the rubric developer block, prompt_cache_key

labels.input: request, extracted plan text, constraint ids and descriptions; never arm, model or grade
labels.rubric: the final rubric, after the last revision
labels.reference: the outcome both labellers agree on (full rule on each labeller's labels)
labels.disagreements: a third blind Opus 5.5 pass at effort high that sees neither earlier label; the report counts them
labels.table_adds: each judge against the other family's labeller alone
labels.metered: through the metering proxy under the judge-calibration lease (the $25 reserve)

part2.cost_check: after the development set on both judges, project the remaining calls from the measured cost per grade; stop and report before any gate set if the projection passes $25

main_merge.refuses: a shard or trial whose run id is not the main run id, a turn with no trial.json that is not infra_error, a trial id twice

part3.note: Amendment 3 part 3: calibration and the plan band recorded, Amendment 1's review-only fallback applied after a plan-band failure, and the main and forced manifests. Committed before any main-stage or forced trial; the main stage launches only from this commit.
part3.decided_by: internal-task chose Amendment 1's review-only fallback (option A); the Captain applied it to the band failure, 2026-11-08
part3.trigger: a plan-band failure with both judges calibrated; Amendment 1's preregistered triggers were (a) a calibration failure on blind set A or C and (b) gstack-plan leaving the edition, and neither happened. The fallback is applied because both failures mean the plan family cannot measure edition against plain. Decided before any main-stage trial.
part3.gstack_plan_verdict_line: gstack-plan: FIX-METHOD: plain frontier plans sit at the floor of this rubric, so the plan family needs a new bank or rubric before any claim about gstack-plan.
part3.repetitions_note: 18 stands whatever the projection; Amendment 1's drop to 12 is a cost-rule fallback, dropped under the 2026-11-07 spend rule as part 1 dropped the 6-repetition one
part3.judge_calls: none: review trials are graded by edition-grade.ts's deterministic review grader; vm-shard.sh still runs judge-shard.ts for the main and forced run ids and it makes 0 model calls on review turns (tests/qm-s1-edition-judges.test.ts)
not_applicable_under_the_fallback: secondary judge (GPT-6.1 Sol) and its family-bias check
plan-family outcomes: per-family plan results, plan exposure, plan judge grades

projection_usd.basis: headroom review trials (24 per model, plain): Opus $0.07649, Sol $0.04552 per trial; edition multiplier 1.232 (pilot)

main_shards.cells: model x block; block b holds rev tasks 6b-5 to 6b; each shard runs its block's 216 trials (6 tasks x 2 arms x 18 repetitions); no cell is split
main_shards.canary_rule: the other seven launch once opus-b1 has 12 counted turns replicated with status ok, none contaminated, and a mean metered cost per trial under $0.20
main_shards.args: --stage main --shards 8 --arms plain,edition --models <opus|sol> --reps 18 --seed 1514 --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-main --tasks-bank docs/benchmarks/2026-11-06-qm-s1-edition/bank/bank-review.json --tasks-seed docs/benchmarks/2026-11-06-qm-s1-edition/bank/seed.txt --only <the block's 216 trial ids>

forced_shards.cells: the same 8 cells; each shard runs its block's 6 forced trials (k1)
forced_shards.when: after all eight main shards have finished
forced_shards.args: --stage forced --shards 8 --arms forced --models <opus|sol> --reps 1 --seed 1514 --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-forced --tasks-bank docs/benchmarks/2026-11-06-qm-s1-edition/bank/bank-review.json --tasks-seed docs/benchmarks/2026-11-06-qm-s1-edition/bank/seed.txt --only <the block's 6 forced trial ids>

exposure_rate.interval: 95 percent task-clustered bootstrap over 24 tasks, 10000 draws, seed 7

part3.main_merge: bun harnesses/qm/gstack/edition-merge.ts --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-main (refuses any other run id); forced merged apart with --run-id qm-s1-edition-2026-11-forced
